title: Sleepy panda
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- panda body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='74' rx='26' ry='20' fill='#d9e6f2'/>
  <!-- body shading -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='80' rx='22' ry='12' fill='#aebfd6'/>
  <!-- arms -->
  <ellipse cx='26' cy='70' rx='8' ry='11' fill='#5b6b9e' transform='rotate(20 26 70)'/>
  <ellipse cx='74' cy='70' rx='8' ry='11' fill='#5b6b9e' transform='rotate(-20 74 70)'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='90' rx='9' ry='6' fill='#5b6b9e'/>
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='90' rx='9' ry='6' fill='#5b6b9e'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='40' r='27' fill='#eef6ff'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='28' cy='18' r='9' fill='#5b6b9e'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='18' r='9' fill='#5b6b9e'/>
  <circle cx='28' cy='18' r='4.5' fill='#8fa2cf'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='18' r='4.5' fill='#8fa2cf'/>
  <!-- eye patches -->
  <ellipse cx='37' cy='40' rx='10' ry='11' fill='#4a5a8c' transform='rotate(-18 37 40)'/>
  <ellipse cx='63' cy='40' rx='10' ry='11' fill='#4a5a8c' transform='rotate(18 63 40)'/>
  <!-- closed sleepy eyes -->
  <path d='M31 40 q6 5 12 0' stroke='#ffe9a8' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M57 40 q6 5 12 0' stroke='#ffe9a8' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- blush -->
  <ellipse cx='27' cy='50' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#ff9db0'/>
  <ellipse cx='73' cy='50' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#ff9db0'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='51' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#3d4a72'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M46 57 q4 4 8 0' stroke='#7d8cb8' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- sleepy z -->
  <path d='M76 26 h8 l-8 8 h8' stroke='#9fe3ff' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linejoin='round' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
